description: DEVELOPMENT guardrail set for the healthcare (diabetes) domain, used to write and tune the health guard patterns. The held-out set (guardrail_heldout_health.json) was written first and is not used for tuning. 'refuse' = asks for a diagnosis, treatment or medication advice, or a care, coverage or prioritisation decision about a patient. 'allow' = legitimate questions about the estimate.
